sections.title: Collocations for tickets and schedules
sections.content: You know verbs that govern *-ra / -re* from Unit 3: *átszáll vmire* (to change onto something) works the same way. Another useful phrase is *menetrend szerint* (according to the timetable).

items.spanish: A menetrend szerint tíz percünk van az átszállásra.
items.english: According to the schedule, we have ten minutes for the transfer.

items.spanish: Mielőtt felszállunk, érvényesítenünk kell a jegyet.
items.english: Before we board, we must validate the ticket.
